quote: JXN Water recently engaged Jacobs as the operations and maintenance contractor for our three wastewater treatment plants and 99 pump stations. They made the transition smooth and painless. Six months into this 10-year engagement we are seeing a tremendous improvement in all wastewater operations compared with the previous contract operator. We could not be more impressed with the entire Jacobs team.
speaker: Ted Henifin
title: Interim Third-Party Manager

quote: Protection of the Naugatuck River is a key priority for our City. We went through a careful process to select our O&M contractor, and I’m very pleased that we chose Jacobs. I’ve seen a lot of improvements since our partnership began in 2018, and I rest easier knowing that Kevin Dahl and his team are taking excellent care of our wastewater system.
speaker: Mayor Neil O’Leary
title: Mayor
